headline: Java Developer | Core Java, Spring Boot, Hibernate, SQL & React
summary: MCA graduate (2025) with strong proficiency in Core Java, SQL, Spring Boot, Hibernate, JPA and ReactJS. Hands-on experience building full-stack, database-driven applications with REST APIs, JDBC and Oracle SQL/MySQL, with an emphasis on clean code, secure coding practices and performance optimisation. Also experienced in Python-based data analysis and time series forecasting, with a published research paper on India's GDP. Familiar with SDLC, unit and integration testing, debugging and agile practices, and seeking a Java/backend developer role.
